## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] A new or changed interface text is in **both** `messages/en.ts` and `messages/id.ts`.
- [ ] If a README changed, **both** `README.md` and `README.id.md` changed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data (an email address, for example) in the change.
